outcomes.name: The risk management approach has been refined based on pilot learnings
The risk management approach is understood across every site/team joining the scaled rollout

actions.action: Review pilot feedback on Planning & Risk to identify what needs to change in the risk management approach before scaling.
Refine the risk management approach to Planning & Risk based on lessons learned from the pilot.
Secure sign-off for the refined risk management approach covering Planning & Risk ahead of wider rollout.
Ensure the refined risk management approach for Planning & Risk is consistently communicated to new sites/teams joining the rollout.
Continuously validate that the risk management approach for Planning & Risk remains effective as the change scales further.
Gather feedback from pilot participants on how the risk management approach affected Process & Sustainment.
Adapt the risk management approach relating to Process & Sustainment for a wider, more diverse audience.
Roll out the risk management approach covering Process & Sustainment to stakeholders in newly onboarding sites/teams.
Monitor Process & Sustainment among stakeholders in the wider rollout and address any gaps.
Use champions from the pilot to help new sites/teams connect with the risk management approach for Process & Sustainment.
